description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in precision as a function of the number of tokens used in a KV cache compression algorithm. The x-axis represents different layers of a neural network, ranging from Layer 1-4 to Layer 29-32. The y-axis measures the relative change in precision, with values ranging from -25% to 5%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration of the algorithm: LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit; LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit; RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit; and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit. Additionally, there is a baseline line for 4×tokens, 4-bit. The lines show varying degrees of change in precision across the layers, with some configurations experiencing significant drops in precision at certain layers, while others maintain a more consistent level of change.
